title: Ozi Ọma n'oge Ochie
intro: Ị na-ahụ oge olileanya na-agbanwe agbanwe. Di na nwunye, ndị gafere oge ịbụ nne na nna, natara nkwa nke na-emegide iwu okike. N'etiti ha ka otu onye nọ ndụ ya bụ ihe ịrịba ama nke ebere Chineke—mkpụrụ obi a kara aka maka ịbụ onye amụma, na-ebu ihe nketa nke ga-adịru ọgbọ dị iche iche. Ònye bụ onye a pụrụ iche?
clues: A mụrụ m n'aka ndị mụrụ m ndị meworo agadi ma ghara ịmụ ụmụ.
Ndị mmụọ ozi bịara dị ka ndị ọbịa n'ezinụlọ m mara ọkwa ọmụmụ m.
E nyere m amamihe na amụma, a kpọkwara m aha n'etiti ndị nwere ndidi.
A kpọrọ nna m enyi Allah, m bụkwa onyinye nye ya mgbe ọ dị obere.
Enwere m nwanne nwoke bụkwa onye amụma, Onyenwe anyị gọziri anyị abụọ.
Nwa m nwoke bụkwa onye amụma, e nyekwara ụmụ m akwụkwọ nsọ na amụma.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: A mụrụ ha n'aka ndị nne na nna meworo agadi
E nyere ya alaeze na akụnụba
Wuru ụgbọ iji zọpụta ndị kwere ekwe
trial.answer: A mụrụ ha n'aka ndị nne na nna meworo agadi

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Aghọrọ m onye amụma nke nwere usoro ọmụmụ nke ndị amụma
E bibiri ndị ya n'ihi ekweghị ekwe ha
E nyere ya ike ikwu okwu mgbe ọ bụ nwa ọhụrụ
outcome.answer: Aghọrọ m onye amụma nke nwere usoro ọmụmụ nke ndị amụma

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
